maria-ops: :loudspeaker: Heads-up — we9re rotating the SSO session cookie signing key and tightening cookie attributes (SameSite and Secure) on 2026-04-05 22:00 UTC. Most Redwood services will handle this automatically, but older SDKs and any code that parses cookies manually may experience login loops. Full migration doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/sso-rotation

deploy-scheduler: Scheduled rollout window: 2026-04-05 22:00-23:00 UTC. Canary on prod-1, then staged rollout across regions.

jess-product: Are dev sandboxes affected or is this prod-only?

maria-ops: All environments are included. Sandboxes will be rotated earlier at 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC to give teams time to test.

samir-devex: We shipped redwood-auth SDK v2.4.1 which supports automatic cookie negotiation and compatibility headers. Please upgrade. Examples:
- Python: pip install redwood-auth==2.4.1
- Node: npm i @redwood/auth@2.4.1

Python usage: ```python
from redwood_auth import SessionManager
sm = SessionManager(auto_rotate=True)
```

ashok-eng: If a service can9t upgrade before the window, is there a temporary opt-out or compatibility mode?

maria-ops: Yes — we9re exposing a 72-hour compatibility header. Add Accept-SSO: v1-compat to requests or enable the compatibility flag in the old SDK. Compatibility mode expires 2026-04-08 22:00 UTC. We strongly encourage bumping the SDK instead of relying on opt-out.

devex-checker: Automated scan found 12 services still using redwood-auth v2.3.x. Owners have been pinged via DM with checklist links.

emily-support: Heads-up for support: customers may hit 401/login loops. Can we get a short KB snippet with troubleshooting steps?

maria-ops: Draft KB: 1) clear cookies, 2) confirm SDK version (>=2.4.1), 3) check proxy adds Accept-SSO header, 4) collect X-SSO-Trace from response and open eng-security ticket if persistent. KB draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/kb/sso-rotation-troubleshoot

ashok-eng: Thanks — we'll schedule SDK upgrades in our next sprint and test against the sandbox rotation at 16:00.

jess-product: :thumbsup:
